description: This file manages resource lookup and path management for the Kivy framework, including functions for finding, adding, and removing resource paths, as well as handling resource URI schemes.

methods.name: _resolve_path
methods.description: Resolves a filename to an absolute path by searching resource_paths.

methods.name: resource_find
methods.description: Searches for a resource in the list of paths, with optional caching and support for special URI schemes.

methods.name: resource_add_path
methods.description: Adds a custom path to the resource search paths.

methods.name: resource_remove_path
methods.description: Removes a specified path from the resource search paths.
